question: For the RBAC action 'access_as_shared' (considering only IPv4 subnets), what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version with subtotals and a grand total, and—alongside those stats—what are the top 3 shared networks by subnet count, including each network ID, its subnet count, and the tenant ID of each subnet (with repeated network IDs suppressed)? Do not return any rounded answers.
generated_sql: WITH shared_networks AS (     SELECT DISTINCT object_id AS network_id     FROM networkrbacs     WHERE action = 'access_as_shared' ), ipv4_shared_subnets AS (     SELECT s.id AS subnet_id, s.network_id, s.tenant_id, s.ip_version     FROM subnets AS s     JOIN shared_networks AS sn       ON sn.network_id = s.network_id     WHERE s.ip_version = 4 ), statistics_rows AS (     SELECT         CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1              THEN 'GRAND TOTAL'              ELSE 'TENANT SUBTOTAL'         END AS stats_level,         tenant_id,         AVG(ip_version) AS avg_ip_version,         VARIANCE(ip_version) AS variance_ip_version,         STDDEV(ip_version) AS stddev_ip_version     FROM ipv4_shared_subnets     GROUP BY ROLLUP (tenant_id) ), network_counts AS (     SELECT         network_id,         COUNT(*) AS subnet_count,         ARRAY_AGG(tenant_id ORDER BY subnet_id) AS subnet_tenant_ids     FROM ipv4_shared_subnets     GROUP BY network_id ), top_networks AS (     SELECT         network_id,         subnet_count,         subnet_tenant_ids,         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (             ORDER BY subnet_count DESC, network_id         ) AS network_rank     FROM network_counts     ORDER BY subnet_count DESC, network_id     LIMIT 3 ), result_rows AS (     SELECT         1 AS section_order,         CASE WHEN stats_level = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS row_order,         'STATISTICS'::text AS result_type,         stats_level,         tenant_id,         avg_ip_version,         variance_ip_version,         stddev_ip_version,         NULL::text AS network_id,         NULL::bigint AS subnet_count,         NULL::text[] AS subnet_tenant_ids     FROM statistics_rows      UNION ALL      SELECT         2,         network_rank,         'TOP NETWORK',         NULL::text,         NULL::text,         NULL::numeric,         NULL::numeric,         NULL::numeric,         network_id,         subnet_count,         subnet_tenant_ids     FROM top_networks ) SELECT     result_type,     stats_level,     tenant_id,     avg_ip_version,     variance_ip_version,     stddev_ip_version,     network_id,     subnet_count,     subnet_tenant_ids FROM result_rows ORDER BY section_order, row_order, tenant_id, network_id

gold_sql: WITH rbac_ip_version_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VAR_POP(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV_POP(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACTION) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE ACTION END AS ACTION, CASE WHEN GROUPING(avg_ip_version) = 1 AND GROUPING(ACTION) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(avg_ip_version AS TEXT) END AS avg_ip_version, SUM(ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance, SUM(ip_version_stddev) AS ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ROLLUP (ACTION, avg_ip_version)), top3_shared_networks_subnets AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.OBJECT_ID AS network_id, COUNT(*) AS subnet_count FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.OBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.network_id) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.network_id NULLS FIRST) = inner_cte.network_id THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.network_id END AS network_id, inner_cte.subnet_count, s.TENANT_ID AS subnet_tenant_id FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = inner_cte.network_id ORDER BY inner_cte.network_id NULLS FIRST, s.TENANT_ID NULLS FIRST) SELECT r.ACTION, r.avg_ip_version, r.ip_version_variance, r.ip_version_stddev, t.network_id, t.subnet_count, t.subnet_tenant_id FROM rbac_ip_version_stats AS r CROSS JOIN top3_shared_networks_subnets AS t WHERE r.ACTION = 'access_as_shared'

question: For each RBAC action that (1) has more than 5 matching DHCP-enabled subnets and (2) is not associated with shared networks (networks having an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), show the action name along with the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP versions; additionally, for the `access_as_shared` action, also display the average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP versions (restricted to IP versions 4 and 6), and order results by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence:
"exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
"access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
generated_sql: WITH matching_subnets AS (     SELECT DISTINCT         r.action,         s.id AS subnet_id,         s.ip_version     FROM networkrbacs AS r     JOIN networks AS n         ON r.object_id = n.id     JOIN subnets AS s         ON s.network_id = n.id     WHERE s.enable_dhcp = 1       AND n.id NOT IN (           SELECT shared_rbac.object_id           FROM networkrbacs AS shared_rbac           WHERE shared_rbac.action = 'access_as_shared'             AND shared_rbac.target_tenant IN (                 '*',                 '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'             )       ) ) SELECT     action,     STDDEV(ip_version) AS ip_version_stddev,     CASE         WHEN action = 'access_as_shared'         THEN AVG(ip_version) FILTER (WHERE ip_version IN (4, 6))     END AS ip_version_avg_4_6,     CASE         WHEN action = 'access_as_shared'         THEN MAX(ip_version) FILTER (WHERE ip_version IN (4, 6))            - MIN(ip_version) FILTER (WHERE ip_version IN (4, 6))     END AS ip_version_range_4_6,     CASE         WHEN action = 'access_as_shared'         THEN VARIANCE(ip_version) FILTER (WHERE ip_version IN (4, 6))     END AS ip_version_variance_4_6 FROM matching_subnets GROUP BY action HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC

gold_sql: WITH subq1 AS (SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV_POP(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND NOT s.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), subq2 AS (SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VAR_POP(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT subq1.ACTION AS action, subq1.ip_version_stddev, subq2.avg_ip_version, subq2.ip_version_range, subq2.ip_version_variance FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACTION = subq2.rbac_action ORDER BY subq1.ip_version_stddev DESC NULLS LAST

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", how many ACTIVE networks exist, what is the most recent network standard-attribute updated_at timestamp, and (for administratively up ports with at least one IP allocation) how many such ports are there along with the total IP allocation count and total subnet-id row count? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence:
Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
generated_sql: WITH network_stats AS (     SELECT         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_network_count,         MAX(sa.updated_at) AS most_recent_network_updated_at     FROM networks AS n     LEFT JOIN standardattributes AS sa         ON n.standard_attr_id = sa.id     WHERE n.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), port_stats AS (     SELECT         COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS qualifying_port_count,         COUNT(ia.port_id) AS total_ip_allocation_count,         COUNT(ia.subnet_id) AS total_subnet_id_row_count     FROM ports AS p     JOIN ipallocations AS ia         ON p.id = ia.port_id     WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')       AND p.admin_state_up = 1 ) SELECT     ns.active_network_count,     ns.most_recent_network_updated_at,     ps.qualifying_port_count,     ps.total_ip_allocation_count,     ps.total_subnet_id_row_count FROM network_stats AS ns CROSS JOIN port_stats AS ps

gold_sql: WITH active_networks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocs AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports AS p JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), tenant_port_ip_summary AS (SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(p.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, SUM(p.subnet_id_rows) AS total_subnet_id_rows FROM admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocs AS p GROUP BY p.tenant_id) SELECT an.tenant_id, COUNT(an.network_id) AS active_network_count, MAX(an.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at, tps.admin_up_port_count, tps.total_ip_allocations, tps.total_subnet_id_rows FROM active_networks AS an JOIN tenant_port_ip_summary AS tps ON tps.tenant_id = an.tenant_id WHERE an.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY an.tenant_id, tps.admin_up_port_count, tps.total_ip_allocations, tps.total_subnet_id_rows

question: For each RBAC action that (a) has more than 5 matching DHCP-enabled subnets on its referenced networks and (b) excludes subnets on networks that are shared via an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry with target tenant `'*'` or `'9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'`, show the action name along with the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version numbers; additionally, for the same action, show the variance of subnet IP version numbers considering only public `access_as_shared` RBAC entries (where `target_tenant = '*'`). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence:
"exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
"public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'"
generated_sql: WITH eligible_subnets AS (     SELECT DISTINCT rb.action, s.id AS subnet_id, s.ip_version     FROM networkrbacs AS rb     JOIN networks AS n       ON n.id = rb.object_id     JOIN subnets AS s       ON s.network_id = n.id     WHERE s.enable_dhcp = 1       AND n.id NOT IN (           SELECT shared_rb.object_id           FROM networkrbacs AS shared_rb           WHERE shared_rb.action = 'access_as_shared'             AND shared_rb.target_tenant IN (                 '*',                 '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'             )       ) ), action_stats AS (     SELECT action, STDDEV(ip_version) AS ip_version_stddev     FROM eligible_subnets     GROUP BY action     HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ), public_subnets AS (     SELECT DISTINCT s.id AS subnet_id, s.ip_version     FROM networkrbacs AS rb     JOIN networks AS n       ON n.id = rb.object_id     JOIN subnets AS s       ON s.network_id = n.id     WHERE rb.action = 'access_as_shared'       AND rb.target_tenant = '*'       AND s.enable_dhcp = 1 ), public_variance AS (     SELECT 'access_as_shared'::TEXT AS action,            VARIANCE(ip_version) AS public_ip_version_variance     FROM public_subnets ) SELECT a.action,        a.ip_version_stddev,        v.public_ip_version_variance FROM action_stats AS a LEFT JOIN public_variance AS v   ON v.action = a.action
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH SubnetIpStddevByAction AS (SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV_POP(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND NOT s.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), SubnetIpVarianceForPublicShared AS (SELECT n.ACTION, VAR_POP(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT s1.ACTION, s1.ip_version_stddev, s2.ip_version_variance FROM SubnetIpStddevByAction AS s1 JOIN SubnetIpVarianceForPublicShared AS s2 ON s1.ACTION = s2.ACTION ORDER BY s1.ip_version_stddev DESC NULLS LAST

question: For each ACTIVE network (with a security binding) that has an RBAC action of either 'access_as_shared' or 'access_as_external' and whose maximum MTU is greater than 8000, list the network name, the RBAC action, that maximum MTU, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version numbers for that RBAC action considering only DHCP-enabled subnets and excluding shared networks (those with an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `'9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'`), keeping only RBAC actions with more than 5 matching subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence:
"exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
"access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
"access_as_external" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_external'"
generated_sql: WITH network_actions AS (     SELECT DISTINCT object_id AS network_id, action     FROM networkrbacs     WHERE action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') ), eligible_networks AS (     SELECT         n.id,         n.name,         n.mtu AS maximum_mtu,         na.action     FROM networks AS n     JOIN network_actions AS na         ON na.network_id = n.id     WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE'       AND n.mtu > 8000       AND EXISTS (           SELECT 1           FROM networksecuritybindings AS nsb           WHERE nsb.network_id = n.id       )       AND n.id NOT IN (           SELECT networkrbacs.object_id           FROM networkrbacs           WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'             AND (                 networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'                 OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'             )       ) ), action_subnet_stats AS (     SELECT         en.action,         STDDEV(s.ip_version) AS ip_version_stddev     FROM eligible_networks AS en     JOIN subnets AS s         ON s.network_id = en.id     WHERE s.enable_dhcp = 1     GROUP BY en.action     HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) > 5 ) SELECT DISTINCT     en.name,     en.action,     en.maximum_mtu,     ass.ip_version_stddev FROM eligible_networks AS en JOIN action_subnet_stats AS ass     ON ass.action = en.action JOIN subnets AS s     ON s.network_id = en.id    AND s.enable_dhcp = 1
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH RbacActionIpVersionStddev AS (SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV_POP(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND NOT s.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction AS (SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb JOIN NETWORKS AS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000) SELECT ahmn.network_name, ahmn.rbac_action, ahmn.max_mtu, raivs.ip_version_stddev FROM ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction AS ahmn JOIN RbacActionIpVersionStddev AS raivs ON ahmn.rbac_action = raivs.ACTION ORDER BY ahmn.max_mtu DESC NULLS LAST, raivs.ip_version_stddev DESC NULLS LAST

question: For each IPv4 subnet route that belongs to an ACTIVE network, list the route destination and next hop, the subnet name and CIDR, and the allocation pool first/last IP (keeping the dense-rank within each subnet), along with the subnet’s total route count, the overall average routes-per-IPv4-subnet benchmark and its route-category label; also include the active network’s ID, name, tenant ID, admin_state_up, MTU, standard-attribute updated_at timestamp, the row number of the network within its tenant (ordered by network name), the average MTU benchmark across active networks, and the network’s MTU category. Do not return any rounded answers. Classify each row’s subnet as 'HIGH_ROUTE_SUBNET' (at least 50% more routes than average), 'LOW_ROUTE_SUBNET' (at least 50% fewer routes than average), or 'AVERAGE_ROUTE_SUBNET'.
generated_sql: WITH ipv4_subnet_route_counts AS (     SELECT         s.id AS subnet_id,         COUNT(sr.subnet_id) AS route_count     FROM subnets AS s     LEFT JOIN subnetroutes AS sr         ON sr.subnet_id = s.id     WHERE s.ip_version = 4     GROUP BY s.id ), route_benchmark AS (     SELECT AVG(route_count) AS avg_routes_per_ipv4_subnet     FROM ipv4_subnet_route_counts ), active_networks AS (     SELECT         n.id,         n.name,         n.tenant_id,         n.admin_state_up,         n.mtu,         sa.updated_at,         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (             PARTITION BY n.tenant_id             ORDER BY n.name, n.id         ) AS network_row_number,         AVG(n.mtu) OVER () AS avg_active_network_mtu     FROM networks AS n     LEFT JOIN standardattributes AS sa         ON sa.id = n.standard_attr_id     WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' ) SELECT     sr.destination AS route_destination,     sr.nexthop AS route_next_hop,     s.name AS subnet_name,     s.cidr AS subnet_cidr,     p.first_ip AS allocation_pool_first_ip,     p.last_ip AS allocation_pool_last_ip,     CASE         WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN             DENSE_RANK() OVER (                 PARTITION BY s.id                 ORDER BY p.first_ip, p.last_ip             )     END AS allocation_pool_dense_rank,     rc.route_count AS subnet_route_count,     rb.avg_routes_per_ipv4_subnet,     CASE         WHEN rc.route_count >= rb.avg_routes_per_ipv4_subnet * 1.5             THEN 'HIGH_ROUTE_SUBNET'         WHEN rc.route_count <= rb.avg_routes_per_ipv4_subnet * 0.5             THEN 'LOW_ROUTE_SUBNET'         ELSE 'AVERAGE_ROUTE_SUBNET'     END AS subnet_route_category,     an.id AS network_id,     an.name AS network_name,     an.tenant_id,     an.admin_state_up,     an.mtu,     an.updated_at AS network_updated_at,     an.network_row_number,     an.avg_active_network_mtu,     CASE         WHEN an.mtu IS NULL OR an.avg_active_network_mtu IS NULL THEN NULL         WHEN an.mtu > an.avg_active_network_mtu THEN 'HIGH_MTU_NETWORK'         WHEN an.mtu < an.avg_active_network_mtu THEN 'LOW_MTU_NETWORK'         ELSE 'AVERAGE_MTU_NETWORK'     END AS network_mtu_category FROM subnetroutes AS sr JOIN subnets AS s     ON s.id = sr.subnet_id JOIN ipv4_subnet_route_counts AS rc     ON rc.subnet_id = s.id JOIN active_networks AS an     ON an.id = s.network_id LEFT JOIN ipallocationpools AS p     ON p.subnet_id = s.id CROSS JOIN route_benchmark AS rb WHERE s.ip_version = 4 ORDER BY     an.tenant_id,     an.name,     s.name,     sr.destination,     sr.nexthop,     p.first_ip,     p.last_ip

gold_sql: WITH RouteDetails AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES AS r JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), SubnetRouteCounts AS (SELECT s.ID AS subnet_id, COUNT(r.DESTINATION) AS total_routes FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN SUBNETROUTES AS r ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.ID), AverageRoutes AS (SELECT AVG(total_routes) AS avg_routes FROM SubnetRouteCounts) SELECT i.DESTINATION, i.NEXTHOP, i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.window_column, src.total_routes, ar.avg_routes AS benchmark, CASE WHEN src.total_routes > ar.avg_routes * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_ROUTE_SUBNET' WHEN src.total_routes < ar.avg_routes * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_ROUTE_SUBNET' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ROUTE_SUBNET' END AS route_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr AND s.NAME = i.subnet_name JOIN SubnetRouteCounts AS src ON src.subnet_id = s.ID CROSS JOIN AverageRoutes AS ar), ActiveNetworkDetails AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'), AvgMtu AS (SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, a.avg_mtu AS benchmark_avg_mtu, CASE WHEN i.mtu > a.avg_mtu THEN 'ABOVE_AVG_MTU' WHEN i.mtu < a.avg_mtu THEN 'BELOW_AVG_MTU' ELSE 'AT_AVG_MTU' END AS mtu_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN AvgMtu question: For subnets on networks shared via the RBAC action `access_as_shared` with target tenant `1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b`, list each subnet’s name and CIDR, the RBAC target tenant, the running sum of subnet standard attribute IDs within each IP version group (ordered by standard attribute ID), the deviation of each subnet’s standard attribute ID from the overall average standard attribute ID across these shared subnets, and (for those same subnets) the DNS nameserver-order coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for IPv4 subnets that is above the overall average—along with a normalized coefficient-of-variation ratio (subnet CV divided by the average CV across the returned subnets).

AVG(ss.standard_attr_id) OVER ()             AS deviation_from_shared_average     FROM shared_subnets AS ss ), ipv4_subnet_cvs AS (     SELECT         ss.id AS subnet_id,         STDDEV(dn."order") / NULLIF(AVG(dn."order"), 0)             AS nameserver_order_cv     FROM shared_subnets AS ss     JOIN dnsnameservers AS dn       ON dn.subnet_id = ss.id     WHERE ss.ip_version = 4     GROUP BY ss.id ), ipv4_cvs_with_average AS (     SELECT         cv.*,         AVG(cv.nameserver_order_cv) OVER () AS overall_average_cv     FROM ipv4_subnet_cvs AS cv ), returned_subnets AS (     SELECT         sm.*,         cv.nameserver_order_cv     FROM subnet_metrics AS sm     JOIN ipv4_cvs_with_average AS cv       ON cv.subnet_id = sm.id     WHERE sm.ip_version = 4       AND cv.nameserver_order_cv > cv.overall_average_cv ) SELECT     rs.name,     rs.cidr,     rs.target_tenant,     rs.running_sum_standard_attr_ids,     rs.deviation_from_shared_average,     rs.nameserver_order_cv,     rs.nameserver_order_cv         / NULLIF(AVG(rs.nameserver_order_cv) OVER (), 0)         AS normalized_cv_ratio FROM returned_subnets AS rs ORDER BY rs.standard_attr_id, rs.id

question: For each subnet name and its gateway IP, among subnets whose network has a RBAC action of 'access_as_shared' and whose subnet has DHCP enabled, find the maximum IP version; then, for each gateway IP, return the highest of those per-subnet maxima, keeping only gateway IPs where that highest value is greater than 3. gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3) SELECT inner_cte.gateway_ip, MAX(inner_cte.max_ip_version) AS max_ip_version_across_subnets FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBNETS AS s2 ON s2.name = inner_cte.name AND s2.gateway_ip = inner_cte.gateway_ip WHERE s2.enable_dhcp = 1 GROUP BY inner_cte.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(inner_cte.max_ip_version) > 3

question: For the top 10 port statuses with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ports’ standard attribute IDs (considering only ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding), show the port status, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and whether any of those ports have a floating IP allocated. generated_sql: WITH qualifying_ports AS (     SELECT p.id, p.status, p.standard_attr_id     FROM ports AS p     WHERE EXISTS (         SELECT 1         FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb         WHERE sgpb.port_id = p.id     )       AND EXISTS (         SELECT 1         FROM portsecuritybindings AS psb         WHERE psb.port_id = p.id     ) ), floating_ip_ports AS (     SELECT DISTINCT fixed_port_id AS port_id     FROM floatingips     WHERE fixed_port_id IS NOT NULL ) SELECT     qp.status,     STDDEV(qp.standard_attr_id) / AVG(qp.standard_attr_id) AS coefficient_of_variation,     BOOL_OR(fip.port_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_floating_ip FROM qualifying_ports AS qp LEFT JOIN floating_ip_ports AS fip     ON fip.port_id = qp.id GROUP BY qp.status ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, CAST(STDDEV_POP(p.standard_attr_id) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ports AS p ON p.status = i.status JOIN securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN floatingips AS f ON f.fixed_port_id = p.id GROUP BY i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

generated_sql: WITH down_ports AS (     SELECT         p.id AS port_id,         p.name,         p.mac_address,         p.admin_state_up,         b.host,         b.vif_type     FROM ports AS p     JOIN ml2_port_bindings AS b         ON b.port_id = p.id     WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' ), port_metrics AS (     SELECT         dp.*,         AVG(dp.admin_state_up) OVER (             PARTITION BY dp.vif_type             ORDER BY dp.mac_address             ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING         ) AS window_avg_admin_state_up     FROM down_ports AS dp ), vif_type_counts AS (     SELECT         vif_type,         COUNT(DISTINCT port_id) AS down_port_count     FROM down_ports     GROUP BY vif_type ), benchmark AS (     SELECT AVG(down_port_count) AS avg_down_port_count     FROM vif_type_counts ) SELECT     pm.name,     pm.mac_address,     pm.admin_state_up,     pm.host,     pm.vif_type,     pm.window_avg_admin_state_up,     vc.down_port_count,     b.avg_down_port_count,     CASE         WHEN vc.down_port_count >= 1.5 * b.avg_down_port_count             THEN 'HIGH_DOWN'         WHEN vc.down_port_count <= 0.5 * b.avg_down_port_count             THEN 'LOW_DOWN'         ELSE 'AVERAGE_DOWN'     END AS down_count_category FROM port_metrics AS pm JOIN vif_type_counts AS vc     ON vc.vif_type = pm.vif_type CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b ORDER BY pm.vif_type, pm.mac_address
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, AVG(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS NULLS FIRST), VifDownCounts AS (SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS total_down_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE), AverageDownCounts AS (SELECT AVG(total_down_ports) AS avg_down_ports FROM VifDownCounts) SELECT i.NAME, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.ADMIN_STATE_UP, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.window_column, vdc.total_down_ports, adc.avg_down_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN vdc.total_down_ports > adc.avg_down_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DOWN' WHEN vdc.total_down_ports < adc.avg_down_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DOWN' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DOWN' END AS down_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifDownCounts AS vdc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vdc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN AverageDownCounts AS adc ORDER BY i.MAC_ADDRESS NULLS FIRST

question: For each administratively up port that has at least one IP allocation, list the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the number of IP allocations on that port, the number of subnet-id rows among those allocations, and the deviation of that port’s IP allocation count from the average IP allocation count across all such ports. question: For networks that are marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0), list each network name and its dense rank when ordered by the RBAC action (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows), along with the total number of such networks and the average number of such networks per RBAC action. question: For each subnet name, report the minimum DNS nameserver order and the average IP version (considering only subnets where the IP version is 4 and the DNS nameserver address is 10.107.23.242/8), and also include the overall average of these per-subnet minimum DNS orders across all such subnets. generated_sql: WITH drive59_ports AS (     SELECT DISTINCT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id     FROM ports AS p     JOIN portbindingports AS pb       ON pb.port_id = p.id     WHERE pb.host = 'drive-59' ), tenant_metrics AS (     SELECT         dp.tenant_id,         COUNT(DISTINCT dp.port_id) AS drive59_port_count,         EXISTS (             SELECT 1             FROM ports AS p2             JOIN portsecuritybindings AS ps               ON ps.port_id = p2.id             WHERE p2.tenant_id = dp.tenant_id               AND ps.port_security_enabled = 1         ) AS tenant_has_port_security_enabled     FROM drive59_ports AS dp     GROUP BY dp.tenant_id ), network_down_ip_totals AS (     SELECT         n.id AS network_id,         COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS down_allocated_ip_total     FROM networks AS n     LEFT JOIN ports AS p       ON p.network_id = n.id      AND p.status = 'DOWN'     LEFT JOIN ipallocations AS ia       ON ia.port_id = p.id      AND ia.network_id = p.network_id     GROUP BY n.id ), network_average AS (     SELECT AVG(down_allocated_ip_total) AS average_down_allocated_ip_total     FROM network_down_ip_totals ) SELECT     p.id AS port_id,     p.tenant_id,     p.name AS port_name,     p.network_id,     p.mac_address,     p.device_owner,     ia.ip_address AS allocated_ip_address,     ROW_NUMBER() OVER (         PARTITION BY p.network_id         ORDER BY p.id, ia.ip_address     ) AS network_row_number,     ndt.down_allocated_ip_total AS network_down_allocated_ip_total,     ndt.down_allocated_ip_total - na.average_down_allocated_ip_total         AS deviation_from_average,     tm.drive59_port_count AS tenant_drive59_port_count,     tm.tenant_has_port_security_enabled FROM tenant_metrics AS tm JOIN ports AS p   ON p.tenant_id = tm.tenant_id  AND p.status = 'DOWN' LEFT JOIN ipallocations AS ia   ON ia.port_id = p.id  AND ia.network_id = p.network_id JOIN network_down_ip_totals AS ndt   ON ndt.network_id = p.network_id CROSS JOIN network_average AS na ORDER BY p.network_id, p.id, ia.ip_address
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH down_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), NetworkDownAllocations AS (SELECT network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) AS down_allocated_ips FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_id), AverageNetworkDownAllocations AS (SELECT AVG(down_allocated_ips) AS avg_down_allocated_ips FROM NetworkDownAllocations) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.port_name, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.device_owner, i.ip_address, i.window_column, nda.down_allocated_ips, (nda.down_allocated_ips - anda.avg_down_allocated_ips) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN NetworkDownAllocations AS nda ON i.network_id = nda.network_id CROSS JOIN AverageNetworkDownAllocations AS anda), drive59_tenants AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59') SELECT i.TENANT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT i.PORT_ID) AS total_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT psb.PORT_ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_port_security_enabled FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON i.PORT_ID = psb.PORT_ID GROUP BY i.TENANT_ID ORDER BY total_ports DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT dp.port_id, dp.tenant_id, dp.port_name, dp.network_id, dp.mac_address, dp.device_owner, dp.ip_address, dp.window_column, dp.down_allocated_ips, dp.deviation_from_avg, dt.total_ports AS drive59_total_ports_for_tenant, dt.has_port_security_enabled FROM down_ports AS dp JOIN drive59_tenants AS dt ON dp.tenant_id = dt.tenant_id WHERE NOT dp.tenant_id IS NULL AND dt.total_ports >= 1 ORDER BY dt.total_ports DESC NULLS LAST, dp.network_id NULLS FIRST, dp.window_column NULLS FIRST

question: For each subnet name and its gateway IP, show the maximum IP version among subnets whose network has a RBAC action of 'access_as_shared' and whose RBAC target tenant is public (`'*'`), keeping only groups where that maximum IP version is greater than 3; also include, for each result row, the overall average of these per-(subnet name, gateway IP) maximum IP versions across all such groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'"
generated_sql: WITH group_max AS (     SELECT         MIN(s.name) AS name,         MIN(s.gateway_ip) AS gateway_ip,         MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version     FROM subnets AS s     WHERE EXISTS (         SELECT 1         FROM networks AS n         JOIN networkrbacs AS r           ON r.object_id = n.id         WHERE n.id = s.network_id           AND r.action = 'access_as_shared'           AND r.target_tenant = '*'     )     GROUP BY ROW(s.name, s.gateway_ip)     HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3 ) SELECT     name,     gateway_ip,     max_ip_version,     AVG(max_ip_version) OVER () AS overall_average FROM group_max
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3) SELECT inner_cte.name, inner_cte.gateway_ip, inner_cte.max_ip_version, avg_maxes.avg_max_ip_version FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(max_ip_version) AS avg_max_ip_version FROM inner_cte) AS avg_maxes

question: For each IPv4 subnet (by subnet name), show the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the DNS nameserver order values across all DNS nameservers on that subnet (excluding subnets that belong to shared networks, i.e., networks granted `access_as_shared` to `*` or to tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`). Do not repeat the subnet name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a grand total row across all returned subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
generated_sql: WITH eligible_dns AS (     SELECT         s.id AS subnet_id,         s.name AS subnet_name,         dn."order" AS ns_order     FROM subnets AS s     JOIN dnsnameservers AS dn         ON dn.subnet_id = s.id     WHERE s.ip_version = 4       AND s.network_id NOT IN (           SELECT nr.object_id           FROM networkrbacs AS nr           WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared'             AND (                 nr.target_tenant = '*'                 OR nr.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'             )       ) ), subnet_stats AS (     SELECT         subnet_id,         MAX(subnet_name) AS subnet_name,         STDDEV(ns_order) / NULLIF(AVG(ns_order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation     FROM eligible_dns     GROUP BY subnet_id ), combined AS (     SELECT         subnet_name,         subnet_id,         coefficient_of_variation,         FALSE AS is_total     FROM subnet_stats      UNION ALL      SELECT         'Grand Total'::text,         NULL::text,         STDDEV(ns_order) / NULLIF(AVG(ns_order), 0),         TRUE     FROM eligible_dns ), sequenced AS (     SELECT         combined.*,         LAG(subnet_name) OVER (             ORDER BY is_total, subnet_name, subnet_id         ) AS previous_subnet_name,         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (             ORDER BY is_total, subnet_name, subnet_id         ) AS row_num     FROM combined ) SELECT     CASE         WHEN is_total THEN subnet_name         WHEN row_num > 1              AND subnet_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM previous_subnet_name             THEN ''         ELSE subnet_name     END AS subnet_name,     coefficient_of_variation FROM sequenced ORDER BY sequenced.is_total, sequenced.subnet_name, sequenced.subnet_id
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, CAST(STDDEV_POP(d."order") AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(d."order"), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d."order") > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(subnet_name) OVER (ORDER BY subnet_name_sort NULLS FIRST, subnet_name NULLS FIRST) = subnet_name THEN NULL ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, coefficient_of_variation FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ROLLUP (subnet_name)) AS tbltmp ORDER BY subnet_name_sort NULLS FIRST, subnet_name NULLS FIRST

Do not return any rounded answers.
generated_sql: WITH down_ip_allocations AS (     SELECT         p.id AS port_id,         p.network_id,         ia.ip_address     FROM ports AS p     JOIN ipallocations AS ia       ON ia.port_id = p.id      AND ia.network_id = p.network_id     WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' ), qualifying_host_ports AS (     SELECT DISTINCT         pb.host,         p.id AS port_id,         p.tenant_id,         p.name AS port_name,         p.network_id,         p.mac_address,         p.device_owner,         p.standard_attr_id     FROM portbindingports AS pb     JOIN ports AS p       ON p.id = pb.port_id     WHERE gold_sql: WITH down_ports_by_network AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), NetworkDownAllocations AS (SELECT network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) AS down_allocated_ips FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_id), AverageNetworkDownAllocations AS (SELECT AVG(down_allocated_ips) AS avg_down_allocated_ips FROM NetworkDownAllocations) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.port_name, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.device_owner, i.ip_address, i.window_column, nda.down_allocated_ips, (nda.down_allocated_ips - anda.avg_down_allocated_ips) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN NetworkDownAllocations AS nda ON i.network_id = nda.network_id CROSS JOIN AverageNetworkDownAllocations AS anda), top_hosts_by_variance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.HOST, VAR_POP(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND NOT ia.PORT_ID IS NULL GROUP BY b.HOST ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT i.HOST, i.standard_attr_id_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.ID) AS total_down_ports_with_ip, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p3.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS tenant_has_any_ports FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b2 ON i.HOST = b2.HOST JOIN PORTS AS p2 ON b2.PORT_ID = p2.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia2 ON p2.ID = ia2.PORT_ID LEFT JOIN PORTS AS p3 ON p3.TENANT_ID = p2.TENANT_ID WHERE p2.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND NOT ia2.PORT_ID IS NULL GROUP BY i.HOST, i.standard_attr_id_variance ORDER BY i.standard_attr_id_variance DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), down_ports_with_hosts AS (SELECT dpbn.port_id, dpbn.tenant_id, dpbn.port_name, dpbn.network_id, dpbn.mac_address, dpbn.device_owner, dpbn.ip_address, dpbn.window_column, dpbn.down_allocated_ips, dpbn.deviation_from_avg, b.HOST FROM down_ports_by_network AS dpbn JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON b.PORT_ID = dpbn.port_id) SELECT dph.HOST, thbv.standard_attr_id_variance, thbv.total_down_ports_with_ip, thbv.tenant_has_any_ports, dph.port_id, dph.tenant_id, dph.port_name, dph.network_id, dph.mac_address, dph.device_owner, dph.ip_address, dph.window_column, dph.down_allocated_ips, dph.deviation_from_avg FROM down_ports_with_hosts AS dph JOIN top_hosts_by_variance AS thbv ON dph.HOST = thbv.HOST ORDER BY thbv.standard_attr_id_variance DESC NULLS LAST, dph.HOST NULLS FIRST, dph.network_id NULLS FIRST, dph.window_column NULLS FIRST

question: For ports that are DOWN and belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, and the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each security group (ordered by standard attribute ID), but only include ports whose standard attribute ID is greater than the average standard attribute ID of all such DOWN ports for the same tenant. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
generated_sql: WITH down_tenant_ports AS (     SELECT         p.id,         p.tenant_id,         p.mac_address,         p.standard_attr_id,         SUM(p.standard_attr_id) OVER (             PARTITION BY sg.security_group_id             ORDER BY p.standard_attr_id, p.id             ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW         ) AS running_sum     FROM ports AS p     JOIN securitygroupportbindings AS sg         ON sg.port_id = p.id     WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'       AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT     id AS port_id,     tenant_id,     mac_address,     running_sum FROM down_tenant_ports WHERE standard_attr_id > (     SELECT AVG(p2.standard_attr_id)     FROM ports AS p2     WHERE p2.status = 'DOWN'       AND p2.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') )
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), TenantAvg AS (SELECT p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.TENANT_ID) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN PORTS AS p2 ON p2.ID = i.port_id JOIN TenantAvg AS ta ON ta.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE p2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > ta.avg_standard_attr_id

question: Among the top 10 (port status, device owner) combinations with the highest number of ports—considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')—return the port status, device owner, total number of ports, the earliest (minimum) standard attribute updated timestamp, and whether any of those ports have a floating IP allocated. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
generated_sql: SELECT     MIN(p.status) AS status,     MIN(p.device_owner) AS device_owner,     COUNT(*) AS total_ports,     MIN(sa.updated_at) AS earliest_updated_at,     BOOL_OR(         EXISTS (             SELECT 1             FROM floatingips AS fi             WHERE fi.fixed_port_id = p.id         )     ) AS has_floating_ip FROM ports AS p JOIN standardattributes AS sa     ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id JOIN networks AS n     ON n.id = p.network_id WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'   AND n.id NOT IN (       SELECT nr.object_id       FROM networkrbacs AS nr       WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared'         AND nr.target_tenant IN (             '*',             '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'         )   ) GROUP BY ROW(p.status, p.device_owner) ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS AS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ports AS p ON p.status = i.port_status AND p.device_owner = i.device_owner JOIN standardattributes AS sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id LEFT JOIN floatingips AS f ON p.id = f.fixed_port_id WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports' AND NOT p.network_id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update ORDER BY i.port_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

question: For the top 3 networks that have the most subnets (considering only RBAC entries where the action is 'access_as_shared' and the RBAC target tenant is public access, i.e., target_tenant = '*'), list the network object ID, the number of subnets on that network, and the number of distinct tenants that own those subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'"
generated_sql: WITH public_shared_networks AS (     SELECT DISTINCT object_id AS network_id     FROM networkrbacs     WHERE action = 'access_as_shared'       AND target_tenant = '*' ) SELECT     n.id AS network_object_id,     COUNT(s.id) AS subnet_count,     COUNT(DISTINCT s.tenant_id) AS distinct_tenant_count FROM public_shared_networks AS psn JOIN networks AS n     ON n.id = psn.network_id JOIN subnets AS s     ON s.network_id = n.id GROUP BY n.id ORDER BY subnet_count DESC, n.id LIMIT 3
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.OBJECT_ID AS network_id, COUNT(*) AS subnet_count FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.OBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3) SELECT i.network_id, i.subnet_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.TENANT_ID) AS distinct_subnet_tenants FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = i.network_id GROUP BY i.network_id, i.subnet_count ORDER BY i.subnet_count DESC NULLS LAST

question: For each port status, list the status value and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by average) of the length of the allocated IP address strings for ports that have port security enabled, restricting to allocated IP addresses in ('10.150.64.113/8'). Do not repeat the status value if it is the same as the previous row. Also include a final TOTAL row across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"

question: For the RBAC action "access_as_shared", show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the subnet IP version (4 or 6) across referenced subnets, and also report how far each statistic is from the overall average of that statistic across all actions returned by the base query. generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ports AS p JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'   AND psb.port_security_enabled = 1   AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM PORTS AS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')

question: For each network, return the network ID and the total number of subnets on that network, considering only ACTIVE networks, excluding shared networks (i.e., networks whose ID appears in NETWORKRBACS with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), and only keeping networks whose total subnet count is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean subnet count across all ACTIVE (non-shared) networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
generated_sql: WITH network_subnet_counts AS (     SELECT         n.id AS network_id,         COUNT(s.id) AS subnet_count     FROM networks AS n     LEFT JOIN subnets AS s         ON s.network_id = n.id     WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE'       AND n.id NOT IN (           SELECT networkrbacs.object_id           FROM networkrbacs           WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'             AND (                 networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'                 OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'             )       )     GROUP BY n.id ), count_stats AS (     SELECT         AVG(subnet_count) AS mean_subnet_count,         STDDEV(subnet_count) AS stddev_subnet_count     FROM network_subnet_counts ) SELECT     c.network_id,     c.subnet_count FROM network_subnet_counts AS c CROSS JOIN count_stats AS stats WHERE c.subnet_count > stats.mean_subnet_count + stats.stddev_subnet_count
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: SELECT n.id AS network_id, SUM(1) AS total_subnets FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS r ON n.id = r.object_id JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON r.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.id HAVING SUM(1) > (SELECT AVG(subnet_cnt) + STDDEV_POP(subnet_cnt) FROM (SELECT n2.id AS network_id, SUM(1) AS subnet_cnt FROM NETWORKS AS n2 JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS r2 ON n2.id = r2.object_id JOIN SUBNETS AS s2 ON r2.object_id = s2.network_id WHERE n2.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n2.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n2.id) AS per_network)

question: For networks that are ACTIVE and belong to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list the network name, tenant ID, and the standard attributes resource type, along with the running sum of MTU values within each admin_state_up group ordered by MTU. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
generated_sql: SELECT     n.name,     n.tenant_id,     sa.resource_type,     SUM(n.mtu) OVER (         PARTITION BY n.admin_state_up         ORDER BY n.mtu         ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW     ) AS running_mtu_sum FROM networks AS n JOIN standardattributes AS sa     ON n.standard_attr_id = sa.id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE'   AND n.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ORDER BY n.admin_state_up, n.mtu
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: SELECT n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID, sa.RESOURCE_TYPE, SUM(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.ADMIN_STATE_UP ORDER BY n.MTU NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')

question: For each port status, what are the minimum admin_state_up value and the average standard_attr_id for ports that are bound with VIF type 'ovs', considering only ports whose device_id is 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7'? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')"
generated_sql: SELECT T1.status, MIN(T1.admin_state_up), AVG(T1.standard_attr_id) FROM ports AS T1 JOIN ml2_port_bindings AS T2 ON T2.port_id = T1.id WHERE T2.vif_type = 'ovs'   AND T1.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY T1.status
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS

question: From the top 10 tenants (by number of qualifying subnets) where the qualifying subnets are IP version 4 and are on networks with an RBAC action of 'access_as_shared' (and whose subnet name/gateway IP group has a maximum IP version greater than 3), show each tenant’s ID, the total number of qualifying subnets, and whether they have any qualifying subnet whose maximum-IP-version-to-window-rank ratio (rounded to 2 decimals) is at least 2.00.
generated_sql: WITH qualifying_subnets AS (     SELECT         s.tenant_id,         s.id,         s.name,         s.gateway_ip,         MAX(s.ip_version) OVER (             PARTITION BY s.name, s.gateway_ip         ) AS max_ip_version,         RANK() OVER (             PARTITION BY s.name, s.gateway_ip             ORDER BY s.ip_version DESC         ) AS window_rank     FROM subnets AS s     WHERE s.ip_version = 4       AND EXISTS (           SELECT 1           FROM networkrbacs AS nr           WHERE nr.object_id = s.network_id             AND nr.action = 'access_as_shared'       ) ), eligible_subnets AS (     SELECT *     FROM qualifying_subnets     WHERE max_ip_version > 3 ), tenant_totals AS (     SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_subnet_count     FROM eligible_subnets     GROUP BY tenant_id ), top_tenants AS (     SELECT tenant_id, qualifying_subnet_count     FROM tenant_totals     ORDER BY qualifying_subnet_count DESC, tenant_id     LIMIT 10 ) SELECT     t.tenant_id,     MAX(t.qualifying_subnet_count) AS qualifying_subnet_count,     BOOL_OR(         ROUND(e.max_ip_version::numeric / NULLIF(e.window_rank, 0), 2) >= 2.00     ) AS has_ratio_at_least_2 FROM top_tenants AS t JOIN eligible_subnets AS e ON e.tenant_id = t.tenant_id GROUP BY t.tenant_id ORDER BY qualifying_subnet_count DESC, t.tenant_id
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetWindowRanks AS (SELECT s.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), SharedNetworkSubnetMaxIP AS (SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3) SELECT swr.NAME AS subnet_name, swr.window_column, sns.gateway_ip, sns.max_ip_version, ROUND(CAST(CAST(sns.max_ip_version AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(swr.window_column, 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS max_ip_version_per_window_rank FROM SubnetWindowRanks AS swr JOIN SharedNetworkSubnetMaxIP AS sns ON sns.name = swr.NAME ORDER BY max_ip_version_per_window_rank DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT s.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS total_qualifying_subnets, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN inner_cte.max_ip_version_per_window_rank >= 2.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_ratio_at_least_2 FROM inner_cte JOIN subnets AS s ON s.name = inner_cte.subnet_name AND s.gateway_ip = inner_cte.gateway_ip GROUP BY s.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_subnets DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

question: For ports whose status is DOWN, list the port ID, tenant ID, host, VIF type, allocated IP address, and the row number ordered by IP address (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row), and also include the DOWN-status range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port (considering only ports that have at least one port security binding), along with the total number of DOWN ports per tenant and the average number of DOWN ports across all tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.
generated_sql: WITH down_ports AS (     SELECT         p.id AS port_id,         p.tenant_id,         mpb.host,         mpb.vif_type,         ia.ip_address     FROM ports AS p     LEFT JOIN ml2_port_bindings AS mpb         ON mpb.port_id = p.id     LEFT JOIN ipallocations AS ia         ON ia.port_id = p.id     WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' ), port_security_binding_counts AS (     SELECT         port_id,         COUNT(*) AS binding_count     FROM portsecuritybindings     GROUP BY port_id ), down_binding_count_stats AS (     SELECT         MAX(b.binding_count) - MIN(b.binding_count) AS binding_count_range,         VARIANCE(b.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance,         STDDEV(b.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev     FROM ports AS p     JOIN port_security_binding_counts AS b         ON b.port_id = p.id     WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' ), tenant_down_counts AS (     SELECT         tenant_id,         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DOWN') AS down_port_count     FROM ports     GROUP BY tenant_id ), average_tenant_down_count AS (     SELECT AVG(down_port_count) AS average_down_ports_across_tenants     FROM tenant_down_counts ) SELECT     dp.port_id,     dp.tenant_id,     dp.host,     dp.vif_type,     dp.ip_address,     ROW_NUMBER() OVER (         ORDER BY dp.ip_address         ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING     ) AS row_number,     s.binding_count_range,     s.binding_count_variance,     s.binding_count_stddev,     tdc.down_port_count,     a.average_down_ports_across_tenants FROM down_ports AS dp LEFT JOIN tenant_down_counts AS tdc     ON tdc.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM dp.tenant_id CROSS JOIN down_binding_count_stats AS s CROSS JOIN average_tenant_down_count AS a ORDER BY dp.ip_address
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DownPortsWithIPs AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, b.HOST AS host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), PortStatusSecurityBindingStats AS (SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VAR_POP(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV_POP(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN (SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id GROUP BY p2.id) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT d.port_id, d.tenant_id, d.host, d.vif_type, d.ip_address, d.window_column, s.binding_count_range, s.binding_count_variance, s.binding_count_stddev FROM DownPortsWithIPs AS d JOIN PortStatusSecurityBindingStats AS s ON s.status = 'DOWN' ORDER BY d.ip_address NULLS FIRST), avg_down_ports AS (SELECT AVG(down_port_count) AS avg_down_port_count FROM (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS down_port_count FROM ports WHERE status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY tenant_id) AS sub), tenant_down_counts AS (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS total_down_ports FROM ports WHERE status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY tenant_id) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.host, i.vif_type, i.ip_address, i.window_column, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, tdc.total_down_ports, adp.avg_down_port_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN tenant_down_counts AS tdc ON tdc.tenant_id = i.tenant_id JOIN avg_down_ports AS adp ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY i.ip_address NULLS FIRST

question: For ports whose status is DOWN, list the port ID, tenant ID, host, VIF type, allocated IP address, and the row number ordered by IP address (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row), along with the DOWN-status range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port (considering only ports that have at least one port security binding). Additionally, only keep ports whose tenant has more DOWN ports than the average number of DOWN ports per tenant, and show each port’s total DOWN-port count for its tenant. Do not return any rounded answers.
generated_sql: WITH tenant_down_counts AS (     SELECT         tenant_id,         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DOWN') AS down_port_count     FROM ports     GROUP BY tenant_id ), qualified_tenants AS (     SELECT tenant_id, down_port_count     FROM tenant_down_counts     WHERE down_port_count > (         SELECT AVG(down_port_count)         FROM tenant_down_counts     ) ), port_security_counts AS (     SELECT port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count     FROM portsecuritybindings     GROUP BY port_id ), qualified_down_ports AS (     SELECT         p.id AS port_id,         p.tenant_id,         mpb.host,         mpb.vif_type,         ia.ip_address,         psc.binding_count,         qt.down_port_count     FROM ports AS p     JOIN qualified_tenants AS qt         ON qt.tenant_id = p.tenant_id     JOIN port_security_counts AS psc         ON psc.port_id = p.id     JOIN ml2_port_bindings AS mpb         ON mpb.port_id = p.id     JOIN ipallocations AS ia         ON ia.port_id = p.id     WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' ) SELECT     port_id,     tenant_id,     host,     vif_type,     ip_address,     ROW_NUMBER() OVER w AS row_num,     MAX(binding_count) OVER w - MIN(binding_count) OVER w         AS port_security_binding_range,     VARIANCE(binding_count) OVER w         AS port_security_binding_variance,     STDDEV(binding_count) OVER w         AS port_security_binding_stddev,     down_port_count AS tenant_down_port_count FROM qualified_down_ports WINDOW w AS (     ORDER BY ip_address, port_id     ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) ORDER BY ip_address, port_id
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DownPortsWithIPs AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, b.HOST AS host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), PortStatusSecurityBindingStats AS (SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VAR_POP(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV_POP(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN (SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id GROUP BY p2.id) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT d.port_id, d.tenant_id, d.host, d.vif_type, d.ip_address, d.window_column, s.binding_count_range, s.binding_count_variance, s.binding_count_stddev FROM DownPortsWithIPs AS d JOIN PortStatusSecurityBindingStats AS s ON s.status = 'DOWN' ORDER BY d.ip_address NULLS FIRST), TenantDownPortCounts AS (SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS down_port_count FROM ports AS p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.tenant_id), AvgDownPortsPerTenant AS (SELECT AVG(down_port_count) AS avg_down_ports FROM TenantDownPortCounts) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.host, i.vif_type, i.ip_address, i.window_column, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, t.down_port_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TenantDownPortCounts AS t ON t.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE t.down_port_count > (SELECT avg_down_ports FROM AvgDownPortsPerTenant) ORDER BY i.ip_address NULLS FIRST

question: For IPv4 subnets that have more than 5 DNS nameserver entries, list each subnet name along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the DNS nameserver order values configured for that subnet, and also include how far that subnet’s order range deviates from the average order range across all IPv4 subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
generated_sql: WITH ipv4_subnet_stats AS (     SELECT         s.id,         s.name,         COUNT(*) AS nameserver_count,         MAX(d."order") - MIN(d."order") AS order_range,         VARIANCE(d."order") AS order_variance,         STDDEV(d."order") AS order_stddev     FROM subnets AS s     JOIN dnsnameservers AS d         ON d.subnet_id = s.id     WHERE s.ip_version = 4     GROUP BY s.id ), average_range AS (     SELECT AVG(order_range) AS avg_order_range     FROM ipv4_subnet_stats ) SELECT     s.name,     s.order_range,     s.order_variance,     s.order_stddev,     ABS(s.order_range - a.avg_order_range) AS deviation_from_average_order_range FROM ipv4_subnet_stats AS s CROSS JOIN average_range AS a WHERE s.nameserver_count > 5
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetOrderRangeVariance AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d."order") - MIN(d."order") AS order_range, VAR_POP(d."order") AS order_variance FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN DNSNAMESERVERS AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC NULLS LAST), SubnetOrderStddevOver5 AS (SELECT s.name, STDDEV_POP(d."order") AS order_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN DNSNAMESERVERS AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY order_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT sorv.subnet_name, sorv.order_range, sorv.order_variance, sos.order_stddev FROM SubnetOrderRangeVariance AS sorv JOIN SubnetOrderStddevOver5 AS sos ON sorv.subnet_name = sos.name), AverageOrderRange AS (SELECT AVG(order_range) AS avg_order_range FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.order_range, i.order_variance, i.order_stddev, (i.order_range - aor.avg_order_range) AS deviation_from_avg_order_range FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN AverageOrderRange AS aor

question: For DOWN ports, list the tenant ID, the tenant’s total number of DOWN ports and average admin_state_up (rounded), along with each port’s security group ID and rank within that security group (by port ID), plus the port name, MAC address, admin_state_up flag, binding host, VIF type, the 2-preceding-to-2-following VIF-type window average of admin_state_up (ordered by MAC address), and the normalized ratio of that window average to the tenant’s average admin_state_up for DOWN ports; additionally, for each tenant include the tenant’s total number of ports (all statuses) and the average port count across all tenants.
generated_sql: WITH tenant_port_counts AS (     SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS total_ports     FROM ports     GROUP BY tenant_id ), average_tenant_port_count AS (     SELECT AVG(total_ports) AS avg_ports_per_tenant     FROM tenant_port_counts ), tenant_down_stats AS (     SELECT         tenant_id,         COUNT(*) AS down_port_count,         ROUND(AVG(admin_state_up)) AS avg_admin_state_up_rounded,         AVG(admin_state_up) AS avg_admin_state_up     FROM ports     WHERE status = 'DOWN'     GROUP BY tenant_id ), down_port_windows AS (     SELECT         p.tenant_id,         p.id AS port_id,         p.name AS port_name,         p.mac_address,         p.admin_state_up,         b.host AS binding_host,         b.vif_type,         AVG(p.admin_state_up) OVER (             PARTITION BY b.vif_type             ORDER BY p.mac_address             ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING         ) AS vif_type_window_avg_admin_state_up     FROM ports AS p     LEFT JOIN ml2_port_bindings AS b         ON b.port_id = p.id     WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' ) SELECT     dp.tenant_id,     ds.down_port_count,     ds.avg_admin_state_up_rounded,     sgb.security_group_id,     RANK() OVER (         PARTITION BY sgb.security_group_id         ORDER BY dp.port_id     ) AS port_rank_within_security_group,     dp.port_name,     dp.mac_address,     dp.admin_state_up,     dp.binding_host,     dp.vif_type,     dp.vif_type_window_avg_admin_state_up,     dp.vif_type_window_avg_admin_state_up         / NULLIF(ds.avg_admin_state_up, 0) AS normalized_ratio,     tpc.total_ports,     atpc.avg_ports_per_tenant FROM down_port_windows AS dp JOIN tenant_down_stats AS ds     ON ds.tenant_id = dp.tenant_id JOIN tenant_port_counts AS tpc     ON tpc.tenant_id = dp.tenant_id CROSS JOIN average_tenant_port_count AS atpc LEFT JOIN securitygroupportbindings AS sgb     ON sgb.port_id = dp.port_id ORDER BY dp.tenant_id, sgb.security_group_id, dp.port_id
official_measure: BEAVER: the same set of rows
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortBindingsWindow AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, AVG(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS NULLS FIRST), SecurityGroupPortRank AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'), TenantDownPortSummary AS (SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS down_port_count, AVG(p.admin_state_up) AS avg_admin_state_up_down FROM PORTS AS p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.tenant_id) SELECT sgpr.tenant_id, tds.down_port_count, ROUND(CAST(tds.avg_admin_state_up_down AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_admin_state_up_down, sgpr.security_group_id, sgpr.port_id, pbw.NAME AS port_name, sgpr.mac_address, pbw.ADMIN_STATE_UP, pbw.HOST AS binding_host, pbw.VIF_TYPE, pbw.window_column AS avg_admin_state_up_viftype_mac_window, sgpr.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group, ROUND(CAST(CAST(pbw.window_column AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(tds.avg_admin_state_up_down, 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS normalized_viftype_window_vs_tenant_avg FROM SecurityGroupPortRank AS sgpr JOIN PortBindingsWindow AS pbw ON pbw.MAC_ADDRESS = sgpr.mac_address JOIN TenantDownPortSummary AS tds ON tds.tenant_id = sgpr.tenant_id ORDER BY normalized_viftype_window_vs_tenant_avg DESC NULLS LAST, sgpr.security_group_id NULLS FIRST, sgpr.port_id NULLS FIRST) SELECT inner_cte.*, tp.total_ports_all_statuses, ap.avg_port_count_across_tenants FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(id) AS total_ports_all_statuses FROM PORTS GROUP BY tenant_id) AS tp ON tp.tenant_id = inner_cte.tenant_id JOIN (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count_across_tenants FROM (SELECT COUNT(id) AS port_count FROM PORTS GROUP BY tenant_id) AS sub) AS ap ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.normalized_viftype_window_vs_tenant_avg DESC NULLS LAST, inner_cte.security_group_id NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.port_id NULLS FIRST

question: For ports that are DOWN and are bound to host "drive-59", show each port’s ID, tenant ID, and MAC address, along with the two running-sum window metrics from the base query. question: For ports bound to the security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c, list each port’s ID, status, allocated IP address, and the running sum of its standard attribute ID within its network (ordered by standard attribute ID), along with (for that same port status) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port, and the total number of ports in that security group having that status; additionally, include the average number of ports per status within that security group as a benchmark and categorize each port’s status as HIGH_STATUS (at least 50% above the benchmark), LOW_STATUS (at least 50% below the benchmark), or AVERAGE_STATUS. Do not return any rounded answers.

MIN(port_security_binding_count)             AS port_security_binding_count_range,         VARIANCE(port_security_binding_count::numeric)             AS port_security_binding_count_variance,         STDDEV(port_security_binding_count::numeric)             AS port_security_binding_count_stddev     FROM port_metrics     GROUP BY status ), status_statistics_with_benchmark AS (     SELECT         ss.*,         AVG(status_port_count::numeric) OVER ()             AS average_ports_per_status     FROM status_statistics AS ss ) SELECT     p.port_id,     p.status,     pi.allocated_ip_addresses,     p.running_standard_attr_id_sum,     s.port_security_binding_count_range,     s.port_security_binding_count_variance,     s.port_security_binding_count_stddev,     s.status_port_count,     s.average_ports_per_status,     CASE         WHEN s.status_port_count >= s.average_ports_per_status * 1.5             THEN 'HIGH_STATUS'         WHEN s.status_port_count <= s.average_ports_per_status * 0.5             THEN 'LOW_STATUS'         ELSE 'AVERAGE_STATUS'     END AS status_category FROM ports_with_running_sum AS p LEFT JOIN port_ips AS pi   ON pi.port_id = p.port_id JOIN status_statistics_with_benchmark AS s   ON s.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p.status ORDER BY p.status, p.standard_attr_id, p.port_id
